title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S21, Terminus: the board
thread:
**Issue #3561 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3561: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S21, Terminus: the board
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the two Terminus spells that remake the board: Black Hole and Slashed Dream Cries in Red.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP3 E7, SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #77 | Black Hole |
| #78 | Slashed Dream Cries in Red |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E7 (#3554): the Black Hole lane and the slashed board.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- Both are E7's geometry, as SP3 E7 reads it: the Black Hole in lane 3 of 5, pulling one lane a turn and closing after 10 permanents; the slash exiling the middle lane and splitting the board into two halves for the rest of the game (Radiant: its caster picks lane 2, 3 or 4).
- The designer's notes on the animation ("a constant animation") and the red mark ("a deep red mark that reveals the endless sea") are binding on the client.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(4) Black Hole, Spell, Terminus, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #77**
Open a Black Hole in midlane. At the start of each player’s turn, it draws their permanents one lane closer. It closes after swallowing 10 permanents.
{For AI: the Black Hole occupies all of midlane with a constant animation. Any permanent that enters midlane is exiled}
~~~
Open a Black Hole in midlane. At the start of the opponent’s turn, it draws their permanents one lane closer.

**(4) Slashed Dream Cries in Red, Spell, Terminus, Mythic, Stinkyscape+, #78**
Slash the board into two *{exiling the middle lane and deleting all permanents inside, for AI replace it with a deep red mark the reveals the endless sea, units and field spells only effect their side of the board, spells have to be played on either of the two boards, only thing that is defacto the same is the hand and health}*.
~~~
Slash the board into two, you have control over the slash *{can pick lane 2, 3, or 4}*
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3554

Part of #3534.
````
